item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-227c9c4b5dd4f95e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"At the January 2024 Central Commission for Discipline Inspection plenary session, Xi stated that 2023 political supervision was to be made concrete, precise, and routine; that formalism and bureaucratism were to be addressed; that officials were to be more strictly supervised; and that disciplinary enforcement was intended to ensure implementation of the 20th Party Congress decisions.","question_ids":["7B.2","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct retrospective account of Xi-directed 2023 governance priorities, published in January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping delivered the speech and attributed the 2023 actions to the Central Committee.","limitations":["Official party-state account; it states intended implementation and reported progress but provides limited independent verification of outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-227c9c4b5dd4f95e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Xi directed a sustained anti-corruption program combining punishment, institutional reform, monitoring of corruption risks, tighter controls over discretionary power, improved supervision of top officials, revised disciplinary rules, and stronger enforcement checks.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.9","8B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Policy directions issued in January 2024 and explicitly describing the 2023 program and the next phase.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping issued the directives at the CCDI plenary session.","limitations":["The source does not establish the independence of the oversight bodies or quantify implementation success during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-227c9c4b5dd4f95e","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Xi called for stronger punishment and recovery of illicit gains from bribery, opposition to political cliques and patronage networks, stricter prevention of family-based misuse of office, and routine removal of misconduct within disciplinary and supervisory agencies.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.4","7B.5","7B.9","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Issued in January 2024 as a retrospective continuation of the 2023 anti-corruption agenda.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping set the policy direction; the speech also assigned responsibilities to supervisory institutions.","limitations":["No case-specific results or independent evidence of equal enforcement are supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-37f7cedefb3d7db6","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The ILO reported that its 2021–2025 social-protection programme supported reforms that improved coverage for more than 84 million people, including informal workers, migrants, refugees, persons with disabilities, and people facing crises.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The report concerns 2021–2025 and is not specific to China or to Xi's 2023 authority.","ruler_attribution":"No attribution to Xi Jinping; the programme concerns ILO support to member states.","limitations":["No material, ruler-specific fact about China in 2023 is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5f5078dfc1ca723e","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Before the revised Administrative Reconsideration Law took effect on 1 January 2024, Beijing authorities conducted online and in-person legal education, public hearings, observation sessions, and agency training; the revised framework expanded the scope of cases, enabled broader mediation, required fuller consideration of parties' views, and introduced one-time correction procedures.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","6B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Activities occurred in November–December 2023; the article was published in February 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The source documents Beijing municipal implementation, not a direct Xi order; national law was enacted under the central state during Xi's tenure.","limitations":["Evidence is local to Beijing and describes preparation and legal education more than completed case outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5f5078dfc1ca723e","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Beijing reported that administrative-reconsideration case intake exceeded the first-instance administrative-litigation intake of the city courts and that the dispute-resolution rate had remained above 30 percent, with the system presented as a principal channel for resolving administrative disputes.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The report describes the situation through late 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding is attributed to Beijing judicial-administration authorities; it is indirect evidence about implementation of national administrative-law reform.","limitations":["The source gives no denominator, time series, or independent audit of fairness or remedy quality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-836fee73eebfd854","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In February 2026, China's Vienna representative cited the CTBTO's determination that its monitoring system detected no event consistent with a nuclear weapon test explosion in June 2020 and reiterated China's support for the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty and a nuclear-testing moratorium.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.4"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The document is from 2026 and concerns a 2020 allegation, outside the 2023 target period.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was made by Ambassador Li Song on behalf of China's foreign ministry; it does not establish a Xi decision in 2023.","limitations":["No material fact specific to Xi's 2023 conduct is established."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5842130a46d079af","start_unit":1,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"A 2023 Cambridge University Press book chapter is titled “China's Surveillance and Repression in Xinjiang” and is identified as a scholarly chapter covering pages 166–189.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Publication metadata is from 2023, but the supplied units contain no substantive findings about events, policies, or outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"No ruler-specific attribution is available in the supplied metadata.","limitations":["The supplied document contains bibliographic information only, not the chapter's factual content."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0403435ed9c7b470","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 29 December 2023, Xi instructed all Chinese ambassadors and foreign-service personnel to implement the Central Foreign Affairs Work Conference, maintain centralized Party leadership, strengthen diplomatic capacity, use multilateral mechanisms and rules, defend sovereignty and security interests, and apply strict discipline and anti-corruption standards within the diplomatic corps.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.8","7B.5","8B.1","8B.2","8B.4","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated to December 2023 and applicable to the end-of-period foreign-policy program.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping delivered the instructions to the participating ambassadors.","limitations":["The source records directives and organizational expectations, not independently verified diplomatic outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c9a2928e85841467","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The CCDI's 2023 work guidance required investigators to maintain zero-tolerance pressure, pursue corruption in finance, state-owned enterprises, food procurement, and other concentrated-resource sectors, target hidden forms such as shadow shareholders and revolving doors, and combine investigations with institutional rectification and post-case lessons.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.2","7B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published February 2023 and describing the operational agenda for that year.","ruler_attribution":"The guidance operationalized Xi's speech at the Second CCDI Plenary Session.","limitations":["It is an official implementation article and does not provide independently audited results or disclose failures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c9a2928e85841467","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The CCDI guidance required investigators to pursue bribe-givers as well as recipients, recover illicit proceeds, use data-driven and penetrating investigations, improve internal controls and procedural standards, and strengthen professional training and discipline within the supervisory corps.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.9","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published in February 2023 as guidance for ongoing 2023 investigations.","ruler_attribution":"The article presented the work of the CCDI investigation department under Xi's anti-corruption strategy.","limitations":["The text describes requirements and methods, not verified compliance or case-level outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2c59f8975bba7a43","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"China's planned 2023 defense spending was 1.5537 trillion yuan, a 7.2 percent increase, the eighth consecutive year of single-digit growth; the government described the policy as defensive and said China would not seek hegemony, expansion, or spheres of influence.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","2B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct 2023 budget plan and official justification.","ruler_attribution":"The budget was submitted by the Chinese government during Xi's tenure; the quoted policy rationale was given by the National People's Congress spokesperson.","limitations":["The source is official and does not independently assess military intent, procurement efficiency, or proportionality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2c59f8975bba7a43","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The government reported that the PLA had contributed more than 50,000 personnel to UN peacekeeping over three decades, deployed 43 Gulf of Aden escort fleets since 2008 that escorted more than 7,000 vessels, and provided medical services to more than 240,000 people through the Peace Ark hospital ship.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical record cited to justify the 2023 defense posture; only partly period-specific.","ruler_attribution":"The figures were reported by the Chinese government in its 2023 defense-budget justification.","limitations":["Historical cumulative figures do not establish Xi's specific 2023 decisions or the overall legality of China's external conduct."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b307fd9f3de643e2","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"At the October 2023 Central Financial Work Conference, Xi directed comprehensive financial regulation, inclusion of all financial activities within supervision, stronger institutional, behavioral, functional, penetrating, and continuous oversight, early risk identification and correction, and punishment of illegal and corrupt conduct.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","5B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated to October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping chaired the conference and delivered the principal speech.","limitations":["The conference identified continuing weaknesses and risks; the source mainly records directives rather than completed implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b307fd9f3de643e2","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The same conference acknowledged that financial risks remained numerous, financial services to the real economy were insufficiently effective, financial disorder and corruption persisted, and regulatory and governance capacity was weak.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","5B.9","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Direct institutional finding at the October 2023 conference.","ruler_attribution":"The finding was adopted in the conference chaired by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The official statement does not quantify the risks or assign responsibility for individual failures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b307fd9f3de643e2","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The conference ordered financial resources toward technological innovation, advanced manufacturing, green development, small and micro-enterprises, and regional coordination; it also called for improved capital markets, housing-finance supervision, local-debt risk mechanisms, and support for social and economic priorities.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Policy programme adopted in October 2023; outcome evidence is not supplied for the target year.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping set the conference's financial-policy priorities.","limitations":["The source establishes planned allocation and regulation, not executed budgets or distributional outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c68546e4877d916e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The World Bank reported that China had substantially reduced child and maternal mortality and infectious-disease rates, expanded health infrastructure, and achieved near-universal health-insurance coverage, while warning that health costs were rising faster than GDP and that an aging population and non-communicable diseases posed growing pressures.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The supplied page presents a long-run assessment and is not dated to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to Xi; the findings concern China over the preceding decades.","limitations":["The evidence is national and historical, not a ruler-specific evaluation of 2023 policy or causal responsibility."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ca5fce6e0add4495","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"At the January 2023 CCDI plenary session, Xi ordered continued comprehensive Party discipline, concrete and routine political supervision of policy implementation, persistent correction of formalism and bureaucratism, and integrated punishment, prevention, institutional reform, and anti-bribery measures.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated to January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping delivered the speech and issued the directives.","limitations":["Official policy statement; it does not independently verify implementation or institutional independence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ca5fce6e0add4495","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Xi directed the creation of a unified, comprehensive, authoritative supervision system, deeper supervisory-system reform, stronger inspection mechanisms, internal controls, procedural and evidentiary standards, and strict discipline of supervisory officials, including removal of corrupt personnel within the system.","question_ids":["4B.4","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.2","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated to January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Xi Jinping issued the institutional directives.","limitations":["The document does not show whether oversight was independent from the Party leadership or whether remedies were available to affected persons."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c44bffed4d0b45d9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Freedom House's China Dissent Monitor documented 583 dissent events in China from January through March 2023; among coded events since June 2022, 78 percent were demonstrations and marches, and at least 29,000 people had participated.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.9","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly covers January–March 2023, with some cumulative figures beginning in June 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The monitor records dissent under the PRC party-state during Xi's rule; it does not attribute each event to a personal Xi order.","limitations":["The figures reflect documented events and may undercount dissent; the source does not establish the outcome of every event."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c44bffed4d0b45d9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The monitor recorded 370 labor protests from December 2022 through February 2023, more than twice the prior three-month count, and linked the increase partly to unpaid wages, the property-sector fiscal crisis, and inadequate labor-rights protections.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly includes January–February 2023 and provides context from late 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies structural and sectoral conditions under the PRC government, without attributing the protests to a specific Xi decision.","limitations":["The report presents contributing factors rather than a quantified causal assessment of Xi's policies."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c44bffed4d0b45d9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The monitor recorded 218 housing protests since November 2022 over stalled projects and related grievances, indicating continued housing-sector dissent during the first quarter of 2023.","question_ids":["5B.9","6B.2","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Cumulative figure includes the January–March 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The protests occurred under the PRC government; the supplied source does not establish a direct Xi order or individual responsibility.","limitations":["The count is cumulative and does not measure the number of affected households or the government's subsequent remedies."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c44bffed4d0b45d9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Among 34 recorded dissent acts by persecuted religious and ethnic communities since June 2022, state repression occurred in 27 cases; the communities included Falun Gong practitioners, Tibetans, Christians, Muslims, and ethnic Mongolians.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","4B.7","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Cumulative evidence includes the first quarter of 2023 but begins in June 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes repression to the PRC party-state, not to a specific personal order by Xi.","limitations":["The monitor's coding and cumulative period limit precise attribution to events occurring only in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c44bffed4d0b45d9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Freedom House documented repression in one-quarter of dissent events and found that local governments were targets in 29 percent of protests but in 55 percent of cases involving arrest or detention.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The analysis covers the monitor's cumulative dataset through April 2023 and includes the January–March quarter.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports state and local-government repression under the PRC system; it does not prove a direct Xi instruction for each arrest.","limitations":["The figures concern documented cases and do not identify the legal basis or outcome of each detention."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-37f7cedefb3d7db6","SRC-836fee73eebfd854","SRC-5842130a46d079af"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are post-2023, bibliographic-only, or not China-specific; they were retained as no-material-fact records where they did not provide a concrete Xi-relevant fact for 2023.","Official Chinese sources frequently report directives and institutional claims without independent verification of implementation, causal attribution, or outcomes."]}
